settings.intro: Azad Jammu and Kashmir (AJK) is a self-governing state. It has its own elected President, Prime Minister, Legislative Assembly, AJ&K Council, Supreme Court and High Court, and its own official flag.
settings.overview: AJ&K (Azad Jammu and Kashmir), nestled in the picturesque Himalayas, is a region of breathtaking beauty and rich cultural heritage. Governed by its own President and Prime Minister under the Interim Constitution of 1974, it is a self-governing state whose final status is to be decided by the people of Jammu & Kashmir through the free and impartial plebiscite promised by the United Nations. Blessed with lush valleys, towering peaks and serene rivers, it is a haven for nature lovers and adventurers alike. Its diverse population, comprising various ethnicities, contributes to a vibrant tapestry of traditions and customs. AJ&K's economy rests on agriculture, tourism and remittances. Its people are known for their resilience and hospitality, and for keeping alive the cause of freedom for the whole of Jammu & Kashmir.
settings.causeTitle: The Base Camp of the Freedom Struggle
settings.causeText: Azad Jammu & Kashmir was liberated by its own people in 1947. Ever since, it has stood as the base camp of the struggle of the people of Jammu & Kashmir for their right of self-determination, as promised to them by the resolutions of the United Nations Security Council.
settings.causeQuote: The question of the accession of Jammu and Kashmir to India or Pakistan should be decided through the democratic method of a free and impartial plebiscite.

glance.title: Tourism
glance.text: A land of roaring rivers and majestic lakes, transparent streams and nullahs, snowy peaks and green mountains, forests and splendid valleys: Kashmir is a paradise on earth. Nature at its best lures travellers from far and near to explore its beauty. Tourism has picked up in recent years with improved road infrastructure, and the GoAJK is committed to making it the top tourism destination in South Asia.

glance.title: Information Technology
glance.text: The Government of Azad Jammu & Kashmir is dedicated to integrating the region into the global digital ecosystem through sustainable ICT infrastructure, an IT-literate workforce and digital governance solutions for public empowerment and facilitation.

glance.title: Education
glance.text: Azad Jammu & Kashmir has a literacy rate of over 70% and a comprehensive education system from primary to university level. The government is implementing significant reforms and investing heavily to raise educational standards. To ensure transparency in teacher selection, the current administration has introduced NTS-based testing.

glance.title: Hydro Power
glance.text: With its three rivers, lakes and snowy peaks, AJK has great potential for hydroelectric power, estimated at over 20,000 megawatts. Mangla Dam near Mirpur is one of the largest dams in the world, and around 4,000 megawatts of hydropower projects are under way in AJK. Once fully utilised, this potential would make a major contribution to Pakistan's energy needs.

timeline.title: Treaty of Amritsar
timeline.text: After defeating the Sikhs, the British sold Kashmir to Gulab Singh of Jammu for Rs. 7.5 million, beginning a century of Dogra rule.

timeline.title: 13 July Martyrs
timeline.text: 22 Kashmiris were martyred outside Srinagar Central Jail while calling the azan, marking the start of the organised freedom movement. 13 July is observed as Martyrs' Day.

timeline.title: Muslim Conference founded
timeline.text: The All Jammu & Kashmir Muslim Conference, the first political party of the State, was formed to give the people a political voice.

timeline.title: Resolution of Accession to Pakistan
timeline.text: On 19 July 1947 the Muslim Conference resolved in Srinagar that the State should accede to Pakistan.

timeline.title: Azad Government established
timeline.text: On 24 October 1947 the people liberated this part of the State and formed the Azad Government, with Sardar Muhammad Ibrahim Khan as its first President.

timeline.title: Kashmir at the United Nations
timeline.text: India took the Kashmir question to the UN Security Council on 1 January 1948. Resolution 47 of 21 April 1948 called for a free and impartial plebiscite.

timeline.title: Ceasefire and UNCIP resolutions
timeline.text: The UN brokered a ceasefire on 1 January 1949. The UNCIP resolutions of 13 August 1948 and 5 January 1949 set out the terms of the plebiscite.

timeline.title: Simla Agreement
timeline.text: The ceasefire line became the Line of Control. The agreement kept the final settlement of Jammu & Kashmir as an outstanding question.

timeline.title: Interim Constitution
timeline.text: The AJ&K Interim Constitution introduced a parliamentary system with an elected Legislative Assembly, President and Prime Minister.

timeline.title: Earthquake and rebuilding
timeline.text: The 8 October 2005 earthquake devastated Muzaffarabad, Bagh and other districts. The people of AJK rebuilt their homes, schools and towns.

timeline.title: 5 August 2019
timeline.text: India revoked Articles 370 and 35A in Indian Illegally Occupied Jammu & Kashmir. AJK observes the day as Youm-e-Istehsal (Day of Exploitation).

days.title: Kashmir Solidarity Day
days.text: Pakistan and AJK stand together with the people of Indian Illegally Occupied Jammu & Kashmir.

days.title: Martyrs' Day
days.text: In memory of the 22 martyrs of 13 July 1931 in Srinagar.

days.title: Accession to Pakistan Day
days.text: Marks the 1947 resolution of the people of Jammu & Kashmir to join Pakistan.

days.title: Youm-e-Istehsal
days.text: Protest against India's illegal actions of 5 August 2019.

days.title: Foundation Day
days.text: Founding of the Azad Government of the State of Jammu & Kashmir in 1947.

days.title: Black Day
days.text: Indian troops landed in Srinagar on 27 October 1947 and began the occupation.

news.title: The Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, met with a delegation from the Muttahida Mahaz Council Garhi Dupatta.
news.body:
The Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, met with a delegation from the Muttahida Mahaz Council Garhi Dupatta. The delegation included Shujaat Kazmi, Muhammad Arif Mughal, Waseem Abbasi, Saqib Kazmi, Sharif Abbasi, Muhammad Nazir Tanoli, and Rashid Naqvi. On this occasion, Commissioner Muzaffarabad Division, Masood-ur-Rehman, and Assistant Commissioner Rural Muzaffarabad, Hammad Bashir, were also present.

Prime Minister Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq stated that steps would be taken for the establishment of a 200-bed hospital in Thotha. The government is taking measures to address the Charter of Demands of the Muttahida Mahaz Council Garhi Dupatta. The government’s priority is to promote collective welfare. He appreciated the identification of issues by the Muttahida Mahaz Council Garhi Dupatta as a commendable initiative. He also announced that visits would be conducted to the Garhi Dupatta Bridge and water supply projects, and necessary steps would be taken to resolve the issues. Additionally, resources will be provided for the approach road to the Karoli Bridge.

news.title: The meeting of the Azad Jammu and Kashmir (AJK) Cabinet, chaired by Prime Minister Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, was held.
news.body:
The meeting of the Azad Jammu and Kashmir (AJK) Cabinet, chaired by Prime Minister Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, was held on Thursday. During the meeting, a resolution was passed expressing gratitude to the Government of Pakistan and the people of Pakistan for their decision to observe February 5 as a day of solidarity with the Kashmiri people. The resolution reaffirmed the unbreakable bond between Kashmiris and Pakistanis, emphasizing that the people of Jammu and Kashmir consider Pakistan their ultimate destination and are willing to make any sacrifice for its integrity and defense.

The resolution strongly condemned the false statements, baseless allegations, and threats issued by Indian Defence Minister Rajnath Singh. It highlighted that the people of Azad Kashmir deeply love Pakistan and that Azad Kashmir is progressing at a much faster pace compared to the Indian-occupied Kashmir. It pointed out that in all economic, educational, and social indicators, Azad Jammu and Kashmir stands ahead of occupied Jammu and Kashmir. While the people of Azad Kashmir enjoy fundamental human rights and personal freedoms, the people in occupied Jammu and Kashmir continue to be deprived of their basic rights.

The resolution also appreciated the role of the National Apex Committee in Pakistan, acknowledging its efforts in uniting the entire nation against terrorism. It emphasized that the people of Pakistan stand firmly behind the courageous armed forces and law enforcement agencies in their mission to eliminate terrorism.

Furthermore, the resolution paid tribute to the sacrifices of the Pakistan Armed Forces in defending the geographical borders, ensuring security, and maintaining peace in both Pakistan and Azad Kashmir.

news.title: PM AJ&K visited to business community Center Plate Muzaffarabad
news.body:
Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, has stated that subsidies on affordable flour and electricity tariffs will continue, urging the public not to pay heed to rumors about their discontinuation. He affirmed that the government is always ready for dialogue and is taking steps to address the issues faced by Muzaffarabad city. Efforts are also underway to form a long-term committee regarding the Peaceful Assembly and Public Order Ordinance.

The historic health package, he noted, will resolve health-related challenges. Measures are being taken to overcome the issues hindering cleanliness in the capital city. The government’s reconciliation committee remains in constant contact with the Public Action Committee. While differences are a hallmark of democracy, the government is fully prepared to listen to the perspectives of protesters.

The Prime Minister assured traders in Plate that their issues are legitimate and invited them to meet in delegations to discuss and resolve their problems promptly. He emphasized that dialogue will certainly take place, and all concerns will be heard and addressed.

He made these remarks during a conversation with traders in Plate. On this occasion, government ministers Abdul Majid Khan, Sardar Javed Ayub, Dewan Ali Khan Chughtai, Advisor to the Department of Services and General Administration Nisara Abbasi, along with administrative and municipal officers, political workers, and a large number of traders, were also present.

news.title: The P M of A J& K, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, stated that he began the public outreach campaign from Haveli
news.body:
The Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, stated that he began the public outreach campaign from Haveli, extending from Taobat to Bhimber, and that this initiative continues. He expressed his desire to personally assess the underdeveloped areas, adding that people are tired of formalities and ceremonial addresses, which weakens the relationship between the public and the state. He expressed these views while addressing a reception in Hattian Bala Bazaar. Present at the occasion were government ministers, including Colonel (Retd) Waqar Ahmed Noor, Diwan Ali Khan Chughtai, Abdul Majid Khan, Azhar Sadiq, Faisal Mumtaz Rathore, Mian Abdul Waheed, District Council Chairman Tayyab Kayani, and others.

Prime Minister Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq expressed gratitude for the warm welcome and extended his thanks to Ashfaq Zafar, noting that he would also visit Zafar’s constituency. He has instructed the separation of university and college campuses. The Prime Minister also announced that the development budget would include the Ali Khan Chughtai Cricket Ground and a 4-kilometer road as part of the development program.

Earlier, while addressing a reception in Sain Bagh, the Prime Minister stated that the journey of public service continues, and that the people’s representative is capable and fully representing them. He assured that the government has a clean record, adding that if anyone can prove even a single instance of corruption against any member of the cabinet, he would resign.

news.title: The President of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Barrister Sultan Mahmood Chaudhry, and the PM AJK, Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq, held an in-depth one-on-one meeting at the Presidential Office, Kashmir House, Islamabad.
news.body:
The President of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Barrister Sultan Mahmood Chaudhry, and the Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq, held an in-depth one-on-one meeting at the Presidential Office, Kashmir House, Islamabad. During the meeting, President Barrister Sultan Mahmood Chaudhry and Prime Minister Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq agreed to raise the issue of Kashmir’s resolution and condemn the ongoing Indian oppression and brutality in occupied Kashmir from the base camp of freedom. They resolved that this struggle will continue until occupied Kashmir is freed from Indian occupation and ultimately joins Pakistan.

They noted that the Modi government is pursuing Hindutva policies, subjecting Kashmiris to severe oppression and injustice. Therefore, everyone must unite to effectively raise their voices against these malicious Indian schemes. The two leaders also held detailed discussions on the political situation in Azad Kashmir, as well as the ongoing development projects there. They exchanged views on matters of mutual interest and other relevant issues.

news.title: PM AJ&K, Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq, handed over the keys of new vehicles to Deputy Inspector General of Police Reserves.
news.body:
The Azad Kashmir government has provided new vehicles to various police stations across the region. The Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq, handed over the keys of these new vehicles to Deputy Inspector General of Police Reserve Dr. Liaqat. Senior Minister and Interior Minister Col. (Retd) Waqar Ahmad Noor, Deputy Speaker Chaudhry Riaz Ahmad, Information Minister Pir Muhammad Mazhar Saeed Shah, TEVTA Minister Sardar Amir Altaf, Food Minister Chaudhry Akbar Ibrahim, Forestry Minister Akmal Hussain Sargala, and Inspector General of Police Rana Abdul Jabbar, along with other relevant officials, were present on the occasion. The Inspector General of Police briefed the Prime Minister, who then inspected the vehicles.

The Azad Kashmir government has provided 19 new 4×4 single-cabin vehicles for various police stations. Each district received two vehicles, while Haveli Kahuta received one. These vehicles were allocated to different stations based on need. The addition of these vehicles is expected to enhance police efficiency. The new vehicles provided by the Azad Kashmir government will be used exclusively for police station operations and will not be utilized for any squad or protocol purposes.

news.title: A meeting of the Public Health Department of Azad Kashmir was held yesterday at Jammu and Kashmir House, chaired by PM AJ&K, Chaudhry Anwar Haq.
news.body:
A meeting of the Public Health Department of Azad Kashmir was held yesterday at Jammu and Kashmir House, chaired by Prime Minister of Azad Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar Haq. The meeting was attended by Senior Minister Colonel (Retd.) Waqar Ahmed Noor, Minister of Public Health Nisar Ansar Abdali, Minister of Communications Chaudhry Azhar Sadiq, Minister of Food Chaudhry Akbar Ibrahim, Director General of Public Health Farooq Ahmed Noor, and District Health Officers.

Addressing the meeting, Prime Minister Chaudhry Anwar Haq stated that the government of Azad Kashmir is utilizing all possible resources to ensure the provision of healthcare facilities in remote and rural areas of the region. He emphasized the need to fully activate THQ, BHU, and RHC centers and prioritize the deployment of doctors and medical staff in these facilities so that people can access healthcare services.

The Prime Minister made it clear that there would be no compromise on the provision of healthcare services to the public. He added that providing healthcare and other basic services to the people of the state is the government’s responsibility. The Prime Minister directed all District Health Officers to ensure the attendance of doctors and medical staff, and take action against absentee employees. He further remarked that establishing merit strengthens institutions, and by maintaining merit, the performance of institutions can be improved.

news.title: The Prime Minister of Azad Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar Haq, stated that he wants to promote tourism in Poonch.
news.body:
The Prime Minister of Azad Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar Haq, stated that by promoting tourism in Poonch, the region’s destiny will be transformed. Through the tourism festival, the world will be able to witness the beauty of this region. As the standard of living improves, the deprivation faced by the people can be alleviated. He also highlighted the plight in Indian-occupied Kashmir, where atrocities like rape are rampant, and people’s dignity is being trampled. There, no one is allowed to hoist the state flag, while our region is peaceful, and there are memorials to martyrs on every inch of Poonch.

The system our forefathers established, which allows full governance over a small region, aims for the freedom of Indian-occupied Kashmir. The people here enjoy better facilities than those in Pakistan’s provinces. Hindering tourism in the name of rights would create difficulties for future generations, which is not fair at all. A large project is being launched to make the area a tourism corridor, which will change the fate of the region.

In the coming days, a lawyers’ convention will be held in Rawalakot, and any positive suggestions that arise will be implemented. The region’s current infrastructure is already in good shape, so we should not cross the red line in the name of rights. I do not believe in regionalism, tribalism, or any kind of discrimination or division. Positions for Chief Engineers have been created in Poonch.

news.title: A review meeting of the developmental departments was held under the chairmanship of Prime Minister of Azad Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar Haq.
news.body:
A review meeting of the developmental departments was held under the chairmanship of Prime Minister of Azad Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar Haq, at the PWD Rest House in Banjosa. The meeting was attended by Senior Minister/Minister of Interior Colonel (Retd.) Waqar Ahmed Noor, Minister of Information Pir Muhammad Mazhar Saeed Shah, Ministers Sardar Mir Akbar Khan, Sardar Amir Altaf, Government Advisor Ahmad Saghir, and others.

Prime Minister Azad Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar Haq directed the officers of the departments that the funds released by the government are for the welfare of the public, and every penny should be visibly utilized for the people on the ground. He emphasized that officers are responsible for getting work done from their subordinates, and they will be held accountable for any negligence. If the poor performance of any department tarnishes the government’s reputation, the responsible officer will be held accountable. Ministers and senior officials should conduct surprise visits, and immediate action should be taken against officers or employees found guilty of negligence.

During the briefing of the Roads Department Poonch, the Prime Minister stated that the Tolipeer Road is a game-changer project, and the necessary funds are being provided, so the remaining work should be completed immediately. Separate funds have been allocated for patchwork on main roads, and their effective use should make travel more convenient. The Deputy Commissioner will cross-check the patchwork and report on it.

During the briefing of the PWD Buildings Division, the Prime Minister instructed that funds for the district jail building in Rawalakot have been provided, and the work must be completed before December so that the prisoners can be shifted there.

During the briefing of the Department of Electricity, the Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir strictly ordered that electricity theft must be fully stopped. He further said that despite the availability of cheap electricity, the lack of improvement in bill recovery rates is a matter of concern.

Senior Minister/Minister of Interior Colonel (Retd.) Waqar Noor, addressing the review meeting, said that the shortage of staff in educational institutions has been addressed, and now there will be no compromise on quality education. He emphasized ensuring attendance through the biometric system to avoid any disruption in education. He also mentioned that a social media app is being introduced to ensure better monitoring of all department officers and staff.

news.title: Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq, visited the Baloch Freedom Memorial of Kashmir and offered Fateha at the shrine of Colonel Hidayat Khan
news.body: Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq, visited the Baloch Freedom Memorial of Kashmir. He offered Fateha at the shrine of Colonel Hidayat Khan, a hero of the Kashmir freedom movement, and made a special prayer for the elevation of the martyrs’ ranks. It was at this same site in 1947 that, under the leadership of Colonel Hidayat Khan and Colonel Muhammad Hussain, people vowed to sacrifice their lives for the Kashmir freedom movement. At this memorial, the people declared Jihad against the Hindu Dogra regime. On this occasion, former Chairman of Town Baloch, Muhammad Abdullah Khan, briefed the Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir about the Kashmir Freedom Memorial. Accompanying the Prime Minister were Azad Kashmir’s Minister of Information, Pir Mazhar Saeed Shah, Nisar Ansar Abadali, Muhammad Akmal Sargala, Zafar Iqbal Malik, Chaudhry Ikhlaq, Sardar Faheem Akhtar Rabbani, and Advisor Sardar Ahmed Sagheer.

news.title: PDO Board meeting was held under the chairmanship of PM AJ&K Chaudhry Anwarul Haq.
news.body:
A meeting of the Board of Directors of the Azad Kashmir Power Development Organization (PDO) was held under the chairmanship of the Prime Minister of Azad Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwarul Haq. The meeting was attended by the Minister of Power Development Organization, Chaudhry Muhammad Rashid, Chief Secretary Azad Kashmir Daud Muhammad Bareech, Additional Chief Secretary for Development Atif Rahman, Secretary of Finance Islam Zaib, Senior Member of the Board of Revenue Zaheeruddin Qureshi, Secretary of Law, and Managing Director of PDO. Secretary of Electricity Irshad Ahmed Qureshi participated in the meeting via video link.

During the board meeting, chaired by the Prime Minister, conditional approval was granted for the payment of salaries to the employees of the Power Development Organization. The board also approved the formation of a Reform Committee for PDO. A committee, headed by the Additional Chief Secretary for Development, was established, comprising the Secretary of Finance, Senior Member of the Board of Revenue, Secretary of Law, Secretary of Electricity, and the Managing Director of PDO. The committee will present comprehensive recommendations to the board within two weeks regarding PDO’s structure, budget, income, expenses, and other matters.

The board also approved the preparation of the PC-1 for the transmission line from Jagran to Noseri. The Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir emphasized that the hydropower sector is of utmost importance, and the government is paying special attention to this sector. He added that the timely completion of hydropower projects would provide electricity facilities to the public and generate revenue.

news.title: Prime Minister of the Azad Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwarul Haq, met with Chairman of the Higher Education Commission, Professor Dr. Mukhtar Ahmed
news.body:
Prime Minister of the Azad Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwarul Haq, met with Chairman of the Higher Education Commission, Professor Dr. Mukhtar Ahmed, at Jammu and Kashmir House in Islamabad. During the meeting, there was a detailed discussion on the financial and administrative matters of the universities in Azad Kashmir. Minister for Local Government, Raja Faisal Mumtaz Rathore, was also present on the occasion.

The Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir said that the Chairman of the Higher Education Commission is playing an important role in resolving the financial and other issues of the universities in Azad Kashmir. He added that the Higher Education Commission has had a significant role in making the universities of Azad Kashmir functional. The Prime Minister emphasized that education is a key focus, and the government is paying special attention to providing quality education so that students graduating from universities can not only support themselves and their families but also contribute to the development of the country.

Chairman of the Higher Education Commission, Professor Dr. Mukhtar Ahmed, assured the Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir that all possible steps will be taken to resolve the financial and other matters of the universities.

news.title: Prime Minister of the Azad Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwarul Haq, met with former Prime Minister Sardar Tanveer Ilya
news.body:
Prime Minister of the Azad Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwarul Haq, met with former Prime Minister Sardar Tanveer Ilyas at Jammu and Kashmir House in Islamabad. Member of Assembly Ali Shan Soni and Government Advisor Sardar Ahmed Sagheer were also present on the occasion.

During the meeting, various matters were discussed, including the situation in Occupied Kashmir, the development of Azad Kashmir, and the political scenario. It was unanimously agreed that a joint and consensual strategy will be devised for the future, focusing on the Kashmir freedom movement and the development of the state.

news.title: A meeting was held under the chairmanship of the Prime Minister of the Azad Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwarul Haq
news.body:
A meeting was held under the chairmanship of the Prime Minister of the Azad Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwarul Haq, regarding matters related to Azad Jammu and Kashmir University. The meeting was attended by Minister for Higher Education Malik Zafar Iqbal, Advisor to the Honorable President Sardar Imtiaz Ahmad, Chief Secretary Daud Muhammad Bareech, Secretary to the Honorable President Muhammad Idrees Abbasi, Secretary Higher Education Chaudhry Muhammad Tayyab, Vice Chancellor of the University Dr. Muhammad Kaleem Abbasi, and Secretary Finance Islam Zaib Khan, who joined via video link.

Prime Minister Azad Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwarul Haq, stated that all possible steps will be taken to improve the university in Azad Kashmir. He emphasized that the government will prioritize resolving the financial matters of the university. The Prime Minister further said that institutions must be strengthened so they can play a exemplary role.

news.title: A meeting of the 27th session of the Cabinet of Azad Jammu and Kashmir was held under the chairmanship of Prime Minister Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq.
news.body:
A meeting of the 27th session of the Cabinet of Azad Jammu and Kashmir was held under the chairmanship of Prime Minister Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq at the Prime Minister’s Secretariat. The meeting was attended by Most Senior Minister Colonel (Retd) Waqar Ahmed Noor, government ministers Raja Faisal Mumtaz Rathore, Chaudhry Muhammad Rashid, Mian Abdul Waheed, Ahmed Raza Qadri, Abdul Majid Khan, Faheem Akhtar Rabbani, Ms. Imtiaz Naseem, Ms. Taqdees Gilani, Chaudhry Muhammad Arshad, Sardar Mir Akbar Khan, Chaudhry Akbar Ibrahim, Chaudhry Qasim Majeed, Chaudhry Yasir Sultan, Muhammad Akmal Sargala, Sardar Aamir Altaf, Nisar Ansar Abbasi, Javed Iqbal Budhanvi, Diwan Ali Khan Chughtai, Malik Muhammad Zafar, Additional Chief Secretary Development, Additional Chief Secretary General, Principal Secretary, Secretary Information, and other relevant officials.

The meeting ratified the decisions made in the previous meetings of the Azad Jammu and Kashmir Cabinet. The Cabinet approved the registration fee for divorce and granted approval for waiving off up to 200 units of electricity bills in mosques in Azad Kashmir where meters are installed. The Cabinet also approved the rightsizing of the Auqaf Department and formed a committee under the leadership of Minister Sardar Aamir Altaf Khan. The committee includes Chaudhry Yasir Sultan, Ahmed Raza Qadri, and Chaudhry Qasim Majeed, and it will present its report to the Cabinet within seven days.

The Cabinet also approved amendments to the Azad Jammu and Kashmir Criminal Law and the rightsizing of the Azad Kashmir Electricity Department. It gave approval to present the Azad Kashmir Building Control Act 2024 in the Assembly for approval. The Cabinet decided to present recommendations for a comprehensive transfer policy in the Azad Kashmir Education Department within seven days.

Additionally, in the Cabinet meeting, approval was granted for a committee headed by Minister Mian Abdul Waheed to review the report concerning illegal allotments in Langerpura and Thotha Satellite Towns. The committee will include Chaudhry Muhammad Rashid, Ahmed Raza Qadri, and Secretary PPH.

news.title: Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq’s Special Message on the Death Anniversary of Founding President Ghazi-e-Millat Sardar Muhammad Ibrahim Khan
news.body:
Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq’s Special Message on the Death Anniversary of Founding President Ghazi-e-Millat Sardar Muhammad Ibrahim Khan

The mission of founding President Ghazi-e-Millat Sardar Muhammad Ibrahim Khan was to free the Muslims of Kashmir from the slavery of Dogra rule and to make Kashmir a part of Pakistan in accordance with their aspirations. Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq

The mission of Ghazi-e-Millat will continue until the freedom of Kashmir and the completion of Pakistan. Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir

Kashmiris will continue the fight for freedom until the last drop of their blood. Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq

Ghazi-e-Millat never compromised on principles and always stood firm on his stance. Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir

The personality of Ghazi-e-Millat Sardar Muhammad Ibrahim Khan cannot be separated from the Kashmir freedom movement. Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq

Both military and parliamentary forces play an important role in the freedom of nations. Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq

Ghazi-e-Millat launched a vigorous movement against Dogra rule. Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir

Kashmiris have neither compromised on their identity nor on their rights, and they will not do so in the future. Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq

news.title: PM AJK, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, laid the foundation stone for the construction of 750 permanent houses for the 1989-90 refugees.
news.body:
Muzaffarabad , July 9, 2024: Prime Minister of Azad Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, laid the foundation stone for the construction of 750 permanent houses for the 1989-90 refugees. The foundation stone was laid by a representative of the refugees. The project will cost 3,096.050 million rupees and will be completed in two years.

On this occasion, the Most Senior Minister Colonel (Retd.) Waqar Ahmed Noor, Minister for Rehabilitation Javed Iqbal Budhanvi, Raja Muhammad Sadiq Khan, Chaudhry Muhammad Rasheed, Malik Zafar Iqbal, Sardar Mir Akbar Khan, Faisal Mumtaz Rathore, Chaudhry Azhar Sadiq, and Ms. Taqdees Gillani were also present.

news.title: A meeting chaired by the P M A J K Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, regarding the prevention of traffic accidents in Azad Kashmir.
news.body:
Muzaffarabad , July 11, 2024: In a meeting chaired by the Prime Minister of Azad Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, regarding the prevention of traffic accidents in Azad Kashmir, it was decided to establish a separate secretariat for the Transport Authority. The Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir has given a 72-hour deadline to make the Transport Authority, Regional Transport Authorities, and Motor Vehicles Examiner fully functional. The meeting also decided to take legal action against those responsible for issuing permits and fitness certificates for vehicles involved in traffic accidents and those displaying criminal negligence.

The meeting was attended by the Most Senior Minister Colonel (Retd.) Waqar Ahmed Noor, Minister for Local Government Faisal Mumtaz Rathore, Chief Secretary Daud Muhammad Bareech, Principal Secretary Zafar Mahmood Khan, Senior Member Board of Revenue Muhammad Zaheer Qureshi, Secretary Law and Justice Parliamentary Affairs Chaudhry Muhammad Sajjad, Inspector General of Police Rana Abdul Jabbar Khan, Commissioner Muzaffarabad Adnan Khurshid, and other relevant officials.

The Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir emphasized that the fitness of vehicles should be thoroughly checked and traffic laws should be fully enforced to prevent the loss of human lives. He stated that comprehensive measures should be taken under a well-formulated policy to prevent accidents in Azad Kashmir, and steps should also be taken for further legislation in this regard.

news.title: A delegation from the Central Bar Association Muzaffarabad, led by President Nasir Masood Mughal Advocate, met with the Prime Minister
news.body:
Muzaffarabad , July 12, 2024: A delegation from the Central Bar Association Muzaffarabad, led by President Nasir Masood Mughal Advocate, met with the Prime Minister of Azad Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, at the Prime Minister Secretariat. General Secretary of the Central Bar Association Waqar Farooq Abbasi Advocate and Hammad Mushtaq Advocate were also present on the occasion.

Prime Minister Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, in his conversation, said that the state’s system has been made compliant with the Constitution and the law. He urged the legal fraternity to support him so that the people of Azad Kashmir can be provided with the facilities of a welfare state. He expressed pride that it should be a matter of honor for the lawyers of Azad Kashmir that the current Prime Minister belongs to their community. He emphasized that lawyers are the enlightened segment of society and play a fundamental role in providing justice and ensuring the basic rights of the people. He urged them to fulfill this duty, acknowledge the good initiatives of the government, and point out any flaws, assuring immediate action.

The Prime Minister stated that serving humanity is his mission and he will continue to do so. He declared that dishonesty and corruption have been eradicated from the state and, as long as he holds power, he will use it for the development and prosperity of his people. He emphasized that his sole mission now is to provide a dignified life to the underprivileged sections of society. He announced the establishment of an endowment fund worth 10 billion rupees to help the needy men and women in society and enable the state to do something for them. A proposal to allocate a 5 billion rupee fund to provide interest-free loans for skilled men and women to create employment opportunities is also under consideration. Additionally, a fund of 1 billion rupees is being set up for educational scholarships for children facing financial difficulties.

He said that the power given by Allah will be taken back by Him, and until then, he will protect the national treasury with complete honesty. The delegation invited the Prime Minister to visit the Central Bar, and he accepted the invitation for a visit at the end of the current month. The delegation praised the Prime Minister’s people-friendly agenda and assured him of the full support of the lawyers of Azad Kashmir.

news.title: Former Prime Minister Sardar Attique Ahmed Khan met with Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq at Jammu Kashmir House in Islamabad
news.body:
Former Prime Minister Sardar Attique Ahmed Khan met with Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq at Jammu Kashmir House in Islamabad. Both leaders discussed the situation in occupied Kashmir, political matters, and issues of mutual interest. Prime Minister Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq expressed grave concern over the worsening situation in occupied Kashmir due to severe human rights violations by India. He stated that India’s persistent obstinacy is a blatant violation of the United Nations resolutions regarding occupied Kashmir. He asserted that the people of Kashmir neither recognize India’s oppressive military occupation of occupied Kashmir nor will they become part of any of India’s political charades.

He emphasized that, in this context, the entire leadership of Azad Kashmir, including political, religious, and Hurriyat leaders, are united in their stance to raise their voices against India on every international forum. He further stated that they will collectively raise their voices for their right to self-determination and will remind the United Nations to implement its resolutions. The Prime Minister urged former Prime Ministers to play an important role in this regard so that they can truly make the state a base camp for the freedom movement. He also mentioned that they are fully engaged in ensuring good governance in the state, and serving the public is their mission, for which no effort will be spared.

news.title: A meeting of the Board of Governors of Cadet College Muzaffarabad was held under the chairmanship of Prime Minister of Azad Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir
news.body: A meeting of the Board of Governors of Cadet College Muzaffarabad was held under the chairmanship of Prime Minister of Azad Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwarul Haq. The meeting was attended by the Speaker of the Azad Jammu and Kashmir Assembly, Chaudhry Latif Akbar, Minister of Higher Education, Malik Zafar Iqbal, Chief Secretary of Azad Kashmir, Daud Muhammad Barich, Secretary of Finance, Islam Zaib Khan, Secretary of Higher Education, Muhammad Tayyab, and other relevant officials. In the meeting, Secretary of Higher Education, Chaudhry Muhammad Tayyab, provided a detailed briefing to the participants regarding the cadet colleges. The board approved the appointment of the Principal of Cadet College Muzaffarabad. The Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir instructed to provide all facilities, including faculty, to Cadet College Muzaffarabad.

news.title: Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq visits Neelum Valley
news.body: Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq, arrived in Karen on his first visit to Neelum, he was warmly welcomed by a large crowd led by the Minister of Information, Pir Muhammad Mazhar Saeed Shah. On this occasion, the Minister of Government, Mian Abdul Waheed, was also present. Prime Minister Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq was taken in a grand rally of vehicles from Duwarian to Lawat Bala. A large number of people participated in the welcoming rally, which included many cars and motorcycles. The participants of the rally raised resounding slogans of “Long Live Pakistan” and intermittently chanted “Pakistan Zindabad” as well as “What is the relation between Kashmir and Pakistan? La Ilaha Illallah.” The participants were carrying flags of Pakistan and Azad Kashmir. Upon seeing Prime Minister Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq, the youth chanted “Long Live Pakistan” and “Long Live Anwar ul Haq.” The Prime Minister was warmly welcomed at various points, and flower petals were showered upon him. At the location of Karen, the local people gave a hearty welcome to Prime Minister Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq with the beat of drums. A large crowd also welcomed the Prime Minister with drum beats at Duwarian. Welcoming banners were displayed at various places along the route of the rally. The Chairman of District Councils, Chairmen of Union Councils, and members of District and Union Councils welcomed the Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir. The most senior minister, Colonel (R) Waqar Noor, and government ministers Chaudhry Azhar Sadiq and Diwan Ali Khan Chughtai also accompanied the Prime Minister.

news.title: A meeting of the governing body of Azad Jammu and Kashmir medical colleges was held under the chairmanship of the Prime Minister of Azad Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwarul Haq.
news.body:
A meeting of the governing body of Azad Jammu and Kashmir medical colleges was held under the chairmanship of the Prime Minister of Azad Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwarul Haq, at the Prime Minister’s Secretariat. The meeting was attended by the most senior minister, Colonel (Retired) Waqar Ahmed Noor; Minister for Public Works, Chaudhry Azhar Sadiq; Sardar Hassan Ibrahim; Chief Secretary of Azad Kashmir, Daud Muhammad Barich; Principal Secretary, Zafar Mahmood Khan; Secretary of Health, Brigadier Irfan Ahmed Khan; principals of medical colleges; and, via video link, Minister for Public Health, Nisar Ansar Abdali, along with other relevant officials. The Principal of Mirpur Medical College provided a detailed briefing to the participants.

The Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir stated that all issues of the medical colleges would be resolved. He emphasized that the shortage of faculty in the medical colleges would be addressed on a priority basis. He instructed the relevant officials to ensure that merit is upheld in all circumstances so that no one has any grounds for complaint.

news.title: Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwarul Haq talks on AJK Assembly floor
news.body:
Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwarul Haq, stated that the Azad Kashmir government has sent a letter to the federal government regarding the completion of infrastructure affected by the 2005 earthquake. Expressing his views on Chaudhry Muhammad Rashid’s resolution in the Legislative Assembly, he supported the resolution. In this regard, the Speaker formed a committee headed by Colonel (Retd) Waqar Ahmed Noor, consisting of Assembly members Faisal Mumtaz Rathore, Diwan Ali Khan Chughtai, Chaudhry Muhammad Rashid, Khawaja Farooq Ahmed, and Sardar Hassan Ibrahim, to discuss this matter with the federal government.

Minister of School Education, Diwan Ali Khan Chughtai, supporting the resolution, said that ERRA is being dissolved and merged into NDMA, and the remaining rehabilitation work in Azad Kashmir should be carried out by NDMA. Professor Taqdees Gilani stated that many schools from the 2005 earthquake are still without roofs, and the completion of hospitals is pending. They expressed gratitude to the Prime Minister of Pakistan for the 23 billion rupee package given to Azad Kashmir and for the commitment to address Azad Kashmir’s pending liabilities. Ms. Imtiaz Naseem mentioned that Colonel Naseem had started the construction of a 22-kilometer road in Bagh, which should be completed.

Minister of Law Mian Abdul Waheed said that ERRA’s mandate should be handed over to NDMA. Pir Mazhar Saeed stressed the need for immediate implementation of Chaudhry Muhammad Rashid’s resolution. Health Minister Nisar Ansar Abdali suggested forming a committee to discuss pending liabilities with the federal government. Opposition Leader Khawaja Farooq Ahmed emphasized that the federal government should provide funds for the completion of earthquake-affected infrastructure.

news.title: Prime Minister of Pakistan, Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif and Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwarul Haq in a meeting in Muzaffarabad AJ&K.
news.body: When the Prime Minister of Pakistan, Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif, arrived in Muzaffarabad for a one-day visit, he was warmly welcomed by the Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwarul Haq. High-ranking officials were also present on the occasion. During the meeting between Prime Minister Muhammad Shehbaz Sharif and Prime Minister Chaudhry Anwarul Haq, discussions were held on matters of mutual interest, including the situation in occupied Kashmir and the developmental process in Azad Kashmir. Prime Minister Chaudhry Anwarul Haq thanked the Prime Minister of Pakistan for his visit to Muzaffarabad and said that the hearts of the people of Pakistan and Kashmir beat as one. He stated that love for the green crescent flag runs through the veins of Kashmiris like blood. He further said that the ideology of accession to Pakistan is our foundation, and it is for this fundamental ideology that Kashmiris have made great sacrifices. He thanked the Prime Minister of Pakistan for granting a historic relief package of 23 billion rupees.

news.title: Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq in a press conference with ministers of the State.
news.body: Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq, has stated that they will establish an Endowment Fund to address unemployment at a cost of 3 billion rupees, under which skilled youth of Azad Kashmir will be provided interest-free loans. Despite Pakistan’s economic challenges, the federal government has provided a historic package of 23 billion rupees. President of Pakistan, Asif Ali Zardari, Prime Minister of Pakistan, Mian Muhammad Shahbaz Sharif, and the establishment are thanked. Kashmiris will never be left alone. The relationship between Kashmiris and Pakistan is strong and enduring, which will continue through generations to come. Joining Pakistan is our destination. Azad Kashmir is a peaceful region, and they will not let it be destabilized. They must play a role in strengthening the state’s system and preventing nefarious forces. Those spreading anarchy cannot be pardoned. They will thwart Modi’s conspiracies to plunge Pakistan into darkness. As long as they are in power, they will not allow any disturbance to their principles. A committee should express gratitude for the success of the public movement. These thoughts were expressed by Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq while addressing a crowded press conference in Muzaffarabad. On this occasion, the most senior Minister Colonel (Retd) Waqar Ahmed Noor, Ministers of Government Raja Faisal Mumtaz Rathore, Mian Abdul Waheed, Ahmed Raza Qadri, Abdul Majid Khan, Raja Muhammad Sadiq, Chaudhry Muhammad Ismail, Zafrakbal Malik, Diwan Ali Khan Chughtai, Muhammad Akmal Sargalah, Javaid Butt, Chaudhry Azhar Sadiq, Sardar Mir Akbar Nisar Ansar Abbasi, Chaudhry Qasim Majid, Asim Sharif, Sardar Javed Ayub, Chaudhry Akhlaq, Akbar Ibrahim, Respectable Imtiaz Nasim, Professor Tariq Gilani, Chairman Prime Minister’s Inspection and Education Commission Peer Mazhar Saeed Shah, Government Adviser Nasir Hussain Abbasi, Special Assistants Sabiha Khanum, Nabeela Ayub are also present. The Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir said that they will work together for the interests of the public and the state.

news.title: Prime Minister of the Azad Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, inspected the under-construction flyover near CMH
news.body: Prime Minister of the Azad Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, inspected the under-construction flyover near CMH yesterday. On this occasion, the most senior minister, retired Colonel Waqar Ahmad Noor, Minister of Communication and Works Chaudhry Azhar Sadiq, and Minister of Government Chaudhry Akbar Ibrahim were also present with the Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir. The relevant authorities briefed the Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir on the flyover project. On this occasion, the Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir directed the relevant authorities to work day and night on this project and complete it as soon as possible. He said that there should be no delay in the completion of the project. The required funds for the project will be provided.

news.title: Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, met with the President of the Central Bar Association, Nasir Masood Mughal Advocate, and a delegation of lawyers at the Prime Minister’s Office
news.body:
Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, met with the President of the Central Bar Association, Nasir Masood Mughal Advocate, and a delegation of lawyers at the Prime Minister’s Office yesterday. On this occasion, Waqar Farooq Abbasi Advocate, Secretary-General, Khawaja Amir Rashid Advocate, Joint Secretary, Shazia Kiani Advocate, Secretary Finance, and Sardar Ramzan Advocate, Secretary Information, were also present.

Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, said that lawyers are the most powerful class of our society. He said that in any society, the role of lawyers is of utmost importance in providing justice, upholding the constitution, and enforcing the law. He said that the stronghold of mafias has been eradicated from the state. The welfare and prosperity of the underprivileged classes of society are our top priority. The money from the taxes of the people will be spent solely and exclusively on the development and prosperity of the people. He said that improvements are being made in all institutions, including education, health, and agriculture.

The Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir said that lawyers will prioritize all issues, including health facilities. On this occasion, the President of the Central Bar Association, Nasir Masood Mughal Advocate, congratulated the Prime Minister on the approval of the Social Protection Ordinance for the assistance of the destitute, widows, divorced, and disabled individuals. He said that he supports the Prime Minister’s initiatives for the welfare and good governance of the people.

news.title: Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq’s special message on Labour Day
news.body: Islamabad: In accordance with Islam, the constitution, and international standards, all measures will be taken for the welfare and prosperity of the workers. The Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir believes in the greatness of labor. Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq says it is the guidance of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) that the worker’s labor should be rewarded before their sweat dries. The Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir remembers on this day the sacrifices of those workers from Chicago, whose sacrifices have now become a global movement. Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq says the progress of the world is the result of the labor of workers. The Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir’s government is taking steps for the betterment of all classes deprived of basic facilities. Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq says reforms in basic health and education will also benefit the working class. In Azad Kashmir, no one will be allowed to exploit workers. Wherever such reports are found, strict action will be taken. Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq says minimum wages for workers, a conducive working environment, facilities for their health, and the protection of their rights will be ensured through legal and administrative reforms. The Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir is ensuring strict implementation of labor laws. Those who earn halal livelihood are the proud people of this society. The Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir says it is through these people that nations progress. They are determined to solve the issues of workers at every level. Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq says we are proud of our workers. The Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir.
