news.title: Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq met with former Ameerr of Jamaat-e-Islami Azad Kashmir Abdul Rashid Turabi along with a delegation
news.body: Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq met with former Ameerr of Jamaat-e-Islami Azad Kashmir Abdul Rashid Turabi along with a delegation. During the meeting, they discussed the current situation of Kashmir, development in Azad Kashmir, and other matters. Also present were Syed Nasir Hussain Hamdani, Chairman Shah Hamdani International Trust, Syed Sikander Abbasi, Former Chairman Shah Hamdani, Syed Noor Muhammad Hamdani, Vice President Shah Hamdani Trust, Syed Atif Hussain Hamdani, Syed Hasan Ali Hamdani, and Shujaat Hussain Advocate. The delegation also extended an invitation to the Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir to attend the International Shah Hamdani Conference. Abdul Rashid Turabi highlighted the objectives of the International Shah Hamdani Conference, emphasizing its role in promoting Shah Hamdani’s teachings worldwide. He stated that scholars from around the world would participate in this conference. It was reiterated in the meeting that joint efforts would be made to highlight the Kashmir issue as it has entered a crucial phase. The Prime Minister stated that we must play our role effectively from the freedom camps and that all parties must adopt a consensus stance on the Kashmir issue. He assured that they would also assure the people of occupied Kashmir that their voices would be heard globally. The priority of the state’s people is to provide employment opportunities, develop the region, and improve the standard of living. The Prime Minister said that serving the people of the state and providing basic amenities are our top priorities. Abdul Rashid Turabi appreciated the steps taken by the government regarding good governance and the freedom movement and expressed confidence in full cooperation with the government.

news.title: Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq and Federal Minister for Kashmir Affairs, Gilgit-Baltistan,Engineer Amir Maqam had a meetinhg at Jammu Kashmir House in Islamabad
news.body: During a meeting between Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq and Federal Minister for Kashmir Affairs, Gilgit-Baltistan, and Seafarers Engineer Amir Maqam at Jammu Kashmir House in Islamabad, the current situation in occupied Kashmir, mutual interests including developmental projects in Azad Kashmir, were discussed. Federal Minister for Kashmir Affairs, Gilgit-Baltistan,Engineer Amir Maqam reiterated Pakistan’s political, moral, and diplomatic support for the Kashmir freedom movement. They stated that Pakistan and Kashmir are inseparable; the Kashmiri people’s struggle for their legitimate right to self-determination will, God willing, be successful. They condemned the atrocities of the Indian army on the oppressed citizens of occupied Kashmir. They assured the Prime Minister of their complete cooperation in developmental projects in Azad Kashmir. They stated that Prime Minister of Pakistan Muhammad Shahbaz Sharif has a deep interest in the development of Azad Kashmir; the cooperation between the federal government and the Azad Kashmir government will continue. Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq congratulated Engineer Amir Maqam on assuming the position of Federal Minister for Kashmir Affairs. They said that the people of Kashmir beat with the heart of Pakistan; Kashmiri people love the land of Pakistan after the Kaaba, they have sacrificed lives, wealth, and offspring for the love of the green crescent flag and are continuously giving sacrifices. They said that joining Pakistan is our destination, and we will achieve this destination. They also exchanged views on the ongoing developmental projects in Azad Kashmir with the Federal Minister for Kashmir Affairs.

news.title: Prime Minister Azad Government of Jammu and Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, presided over a session on development.
news.body:
Under the presidency of Prime Minister Azad Government of Jammu and Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, a review session was held regarding development. In the session, a review of progress was taken on various sectors. Additional Chief Secretary Development, Madhat Shahzad, briefed the Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir on progress in sectors including roads, health, education, electricity, tourism, and others. Chief Secretary of Azad Kashmir, Dawood Muhammad Bareech, participated in the meeting via video link, while Additional Chief Secretary Development, Madhat Shahzad, Principal Secretary Zafar Mahmood Khan, Secretary Finance Lieutenant (R) Islam Zaib, Accountant General Azad Kashmir Tafakur Ali Asdi, Secretary Electricity Arshad Qureshi, and other relevant officials were also present.

Addressing the session, Prime Minister Azad Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq said that the government will provide ample funds for timely completion of development projects so that the public can benefit from their completion. He emphasized special attention to all sectors including tourism, roads, local government, electricity, and education in Azad Kashmir. The Prime Minister said that all possible measures are being taken to improve road infrastructure to promote tourism in Azad Kashmir. He said that tourism industry has gained importance worldwide, and Azad Kashmir is a beautiful region, so ample measures will be taken to promote tourism. The Prime Minister directed the relevant authorities to expedite work on road projects, especially in Neelum Valley, during this work season.

The Prime Minister stated that there is no shortage of funds for development projects. All ongoing projects will be completed soon. The Prime Minister instructed to provide a progress report regarding releases and expenditures. He said that funds will not be lacking for developmental projects.

news.title: Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, inaugurates the road construction and rehabilitation in Kotla
news.body: Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, has said that the government of the state is taking all possible measures to alleviate the sense of deprivation among the people. Welfare of the impoverished classes and eradication of poverty from the state are among the top priorities. From Neelum to Chamb, there will be governance under one law. Under the Endowment Fund, financial assistance will be provided to widows, orphans, divorced women, the elderly, and disabled individuals at their doorsteps to eliminate poverty from Azad Kashmir. Prime Minister Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq expressed these views while addressing the Iftar dinner hosted by Wazir-e-Azad Life Fisheries and Development Authority during his visit to Kotli yesterday. On this occasion, government ministers Sardar Javaid Ayub, Mian Abdul Wahid, and Javaid Iqbal Baddhanvi also addressed, while Ministers of Government Chaudhry Azhar Siddique, Sardar Mir Akbar Khan, Faisal Mumtaz Rathore, Nasir Ansar Abdali, women, People’s Party workers, and a large number of people from Kotli constituency were also present. Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, said that any society cannot function properly if there is injustice in it. He said that he has come with the determination to spend the money of the people’s taxes on their welfare and prosperity and will use all means to complete this mission. The Prime Minister said that corruption and maladministration must be eradicated from the root so that the rule of law and merit is established in the state. He said that serving the poor people of the state, their welfare and prosperity, and the eradication of poverty from the region are among the government’s top priorities.

news.title: Prime Minister of Azad Government, State of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq talks with media in a ceremony.
news.body: Prime Minister of Azad Government, State of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, has said that he will fight to the last constitutional limit to uphold the oath he has taken and protect the rights and dignity of the proud people of the state. The price of making difficult decisions in the lives of nations must be paid. I am trying to put the ruined system back on its feet. It will take some time. No society in the world can progress until the process of accountability and reward is in place. Extremism in Azad Kashmir was constitutionally protected, now everyone will be afraid of extremism and corruption when indulging in it. Poverty has completely drained the common man at the moment. This state is running on the taxes of the people, its protection is the responsibility of the government. A government was found in which there was nothing but ashes. Today, Alhamdulillah, a little greenery is visible, but we have paid its price. For the first time in history, 25% savings have been made in the normal budget. All this will be spent on the people. I will keep talking about the sorrows and sufferings of the people. This limited region has been shaken to its roots by regionalism, fraternity, corruption, rent mafia, and extremism. State will uproot the corruption and extremism from the root. Those who plundered the resources of the state have been buried. Health education and road projects in Azad Kashmir will come to light. A Rs 10 billion endowment fund has been established under the Social Protection Program to eliminate poverty by fifty percent from the lower level. Under this, Azad Kashmir will provide financial assistance to widows, divorced, disabled, and elderly people without hurting their self-respect. Buildings and equipment will be provided to the elderly. All issues of forest employees will be resolved. Forests are valuable assets for our future generations. Forest protection is our top priority. The beauty of the state is due to the forests. Prime Minister Azad Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq expressed these views while addressing the ceremony organized by Forester/Forest Guard Action. Ministers of Government, Mian Abdul Wahid, Sardar Javaid Ayub, Muhammad Akmal Sargala, Nasir Ansar Abbasi, Javaid Iqbal Budhanvi, Zafar Iqbal Malik, Chaudhry Qasim Majid, Chairman Examination and Operation Commission, Peer Mazhar Saeed also addressed the ceremony. While on this occasion, Minister of Government, Chaudhry Azhar Sadiq, Secretary Government, Heads of Departments, Department of Forests, and a large number of forest employees were also present. The Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir said that the state has no shortage of resources to improve the welfare and prosperity of the people and to enhance the capacity building of institutions. There are no means for corruption and extremism. We will have to bring about change in our views. Soon, the fruits of our actions will be visible to the people of Azad Kashmir. I will work with full transparency for this, no matter what the cost. Prime Minister said that the status quo in Azad Kashmir has been uprooted from the ground. I will never compromise on my moral principles. I will turn Azad into a medical city. Buildings will be built in schools and colleges of Azad Kashmir. Efforts of the establishment will be successful and projects of Shounter and Jagraan 2 will be signed. These projects are game changers for the prosperity of Azad Kashmir.

news.title: Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, chaired a high-level meeting of the governing body of Azad Jammu and Kashmir Medical Colleges,
news.body:
Under the chairmanship of Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, a high-level meeting of the governing body of Azad Jammu and Kashmir Medical Colleges was held. Minister of Government Chaudhry Muhammad Rashid was also present. In the meeting, through a video link, the Minister of Health for Azad Kashmir, Nasir Ansar Abbasi, Chief Secretary of Azad Kashmir, Dawood Muhammad Bariach, Special Secretary Health Rashed Haneef, Principals of Medical Colleges, and other relevant officials participated. Special Secretary Health Rashed Haneef provided a detailed briefing on the budget, faculty shortage, and other matters of Azad Jammu and Kashmir Medical Colleges.

Approval for the budget of the fiscal year 2023-24 for all three medical colleges of Azad Kashmir, including Muzaffarabad, Rawalakot, and Mirpur, was also granted in the governing body meeting. A budget of 243.249 million rupees was approved for Muzaffarabad Medical College, 243.616 million rupees for Mirpur Medical College, and 230.469 million rupees for Ponch Medical College. Approvals were also given for the appointments of professors and assistant professors in the medical colleges.

The Prime Minister stated that no compromise would be made on the quality of education. Staff shortages will be addressed on a priority basis. The Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir said that the students graduating from medical colleges are our future. The government will provide all necessary resources to medical colleges so that they can provide quality education to medical students.

news.title: Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, visited the residence of Colonel Syed Kashif Ali, who was martyred in an incident.
news.body:
آ

Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, visited the residence of Colonel Syed Kashif Ali, who was martyred in an incident, and offered condolences to his family, expressing solidarity. Most senior Minister Colonel (Retired) Waqar Noor, government ministers Mian Abdul Wahid, Chaudhry Azhar Sadiq, and Chaudhry Akbar Ibrahim were also present with him. The Prime Minister prayed that may Allah Almighty elevate the ranks of the martyred and grant patience to the bereaved.

During the Prime Minister’s visit, in Tehla Gang, Azad Kashmir, he also visited the house of Captain Ahmed Badar, who was martyred, and offered condolences to his respected father and other bereaved family members. He prayed that may Allah Almighty elevate the ranks of the martyred Captain and grant patience to the bereaved. On this occasion, while conversing briefly, Prime Minister Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq said that the nation is proud of its armed forces, which have made unparalleled sacrifices in the war against terrorism. He said that the officers and soldiers of the Pakistani army have bravely confronted terrorists and eliminated the curse of terrorism from Pakistani soil. He said that the nation pays homage to its martyrs and honors their relatives, who sacrificed for the safety of their beloved homeland.

news.title: Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq while giving a TV Interview.
news.body:
Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, has said, “Alhamdulillah, we have eradicated mafias from Azad Kashmir. The timber mafia, cigarette mafia, and food mafia are all now part of the past in Azad Kashmir.” He took the oath of office, and governance in Azad Kashmir was in a state of disarray. Today, Alhamdulillah, the governance system has returned to track. Governance begins with the enforcement of law and accountability system, and the enforcement of law begins with the Prime Minister’s personality. The Prime Minister expressed these views in a private TV channel interview.

Prime Minister Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq said, “Whenever Allah gives power to someone, the sense of responsibility increases exponentially. And if this doesn’t happen, it’s unfortunate, which has a heavy price to pay in this world and in the Hereafter. Alhamdulillah, I understand that as long as I have power, I am accountable to the people of Kashmir and above all to the Creator of the universe who has given me this power. I took over as Prime Minister on April 20, and by March 20, 2024, eleven months will be completed. When I took the oath, the governance structure of Azad Kashmir was in a state of disarray, resembling the October 8 earthquake. It was in a state of bed governance and corruption, and nothing else. Alhamdulillah, I am justified in saying that I have eradicated mafias in Azad Kashmir. The timber mafia, cigarette mafia, and food mafia are all now stories of the past in Azad Kashmir.”

He said, “Besides, the most important task that is the government’s concept of good governance starts with two things: the enforcement of the law and its application, which begins with the Prime Minister’s personality. I made myself accountable to the law and started accountability from my own personality. The second thing is the institution of accountability, which was abandoned, has been revived, and the Chairman of the Accountability Bureau has been appointed. A Public Service Commission institution, which is related to the future of our young boys and girls, I established such a Public Service Commission whose Chairman even the Prime Minister couldn’t dare to call. Besides that, austerity measures were taken, government transport was being misused and misuse of law was being done, which was stopped. Luxury vehicles were confiscated. About 400 vehicles have been confiscated. Transport policy has been made effective to the extent that government vehicles are no longer used for anything other than official work. The Prime Minister also tries not to use government vehicles after two o’clock. For weddings, funerals, going to happy or sad occasions, I go in a private car. Supplementary grants have always been received in the budget of the Prime Minister’s House. For the first time, this miracle will happen in the budget of the Secretariat of Azad Kashmir that by June 30, 51 percent will appear cut. It was my long-standing dream that for the destitute, widows, divorced women, divorced women, childless elderly men and women, orphaned children, and disabled persons in Azad Kashmir, a special protection program should be started. Alhamdulillah, with the help of the establishment, and I have no other opinion to say here, the vision of the Chief of Army Staff General Asim Munir was that a Special Protection Program should be started in Azad Kashmir.”

Overall, the Prime Minister’s statement highlights significant reforms and efforts undertaken to tackle corruption and improve governance in Azad Jammu and Kashmir.

news.title: Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq inaugurated Shah Sultan Bridge.
news.body:
Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq stated that efforts have been made over the past twenty to thirty years to uproot entrenched status quo. We are trustees of all resources of the state. We are taking comprehensive measures to establish a transparent government system in place of the dilapidated governance system. Corruption, nepotism, merit violations in Azad Kashmir will be eradicated. I am not convinced by mere announcements; public projects will be visible on the ground. By June 30th, education, local government, health, public works, hydel, and tourism statuses will be completely transparent, and people will witness change. In each electoral constituency, developmental projects worth more than 1 billion will be visible by June 30th. The government ministers and cabinet are accountable to every citizen of the state regarding public projects and government performance. When the oath was taken, the market of malpractices and corruption was thriving; there was no program for the welfare of the state on paper. To be part of developed nations, the status quo must be broken. I won’t indulge in anyone’s blackmailing. I’ll continue to do my work in a constitutional manner. I’ll bury politics of status quo. The day I realize that there’s no alignment between my conscience and oath, I’ll step down. Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq expressed these views while addressing the inauguration ceremony of Shah Sultan Tower.

Speaking at the inauguration ceremony, Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq inaugurated the 120-meter Shah Sultan Tower in Muzaffarabad, which was constructed at a cost of 528.321 million rupees. The relevant authorities briefed the Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir on the project’s standards and timely completion. Senior Most Minister Colonel (Retired) Waqar Ahmed Noor, Opposition Leader Khawaja Farooq Ahmed, Ministers Faisal Mumtaz Rathore, Sardar Javaid Ayub, Raja Muhammad Sadiq Khan, Dewan Ali Khan Chughtai, Nisar Ansar Abdullahi, Akmal Sargala, Sardar Mir Akbar Khan, Chaudhry Muhammad Rashid, Chaudhry Yasser Sultan, Javaid Butt, Fahim Akhtar Rabbani, Malik Muhammad Zafr, Asim Sharif Butt, Chaudhry Qasim Majid, Respectable Taqueedas Gilani, Secretaries of Government Officials, Heads of Departments, Women, and a large number of citizens were also present on the occasion.

news.title: Prime Minister of Pakistan Mian Muhammad Shahbaz Sharif and Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq had a meeting at the Prime Minister’s Secretariat AJK.
news.body:
Prime Minister of Pakistan Mian Muhammad Shahbaz Sharif and Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq had a meeting at the Prime Minister’s Secretariat. Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir congratulated Prime Minister Mian Muhammad Shahbaz on assuming office and expressed good wishes. Prime Minister of Pakistan Mian Muhammad Shahbaz assured unconditional support for Azad Jammu and Kashmir from Pakistan. He said that in the pursuit of Kashmiris’ right to self-determination, we will stand shoulder to shoulder with them. Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq expressed gratitude for Prime Minister of Pakistan’s visit to Azad Jammu and Kashmir and said that it indicates Pakistanis’ hearts beat with their Kashmiri brothers and sisters. Prior to this, Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq welcomed Prime Minister Mian Muhammad Shahbaz Sharif at the helipad.

Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq congratulated Prime Minister of Pakistan Mian Muhammad Shahbaz Sharif on being elected Prime Minister of Pakistan, expressing gratitude for his sincere efforts to express solidarity with the Kashmiris in this difficult time. He said that your visit will further increase the love for the country in the hearts of Kashmiris. There is a need for further improvement measures to deal with natural and man-made disasters in Azad Kashmir, including strengthening institutions such as SDMA/Rescue 1122, on which the government is effectively working. The presence of Prime Minister of Pakistan among the affected has boosted our and the affected people’s morale, for which I am thankful to you. The people and government of Pakistan have always extended more than expected support to the people and government of Azad Jammu and Kashmir in difficult times, and your visit today is a continuation of this tradition. Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir expressed these sentiments while addressing the distribution ceremony of relief checks to the rain and snow affected.

Prime Minister said that the area of Azad Jammu and Kashmir is extremely important in terms of climatic and geographical conditions. It is one of the most affected regions by climate change. This region is densely populated on extremely active fault lines, besides flash floods, river floods, heavy rainfall, and snowfall exacerbate the problems of the people. He said that whether it is the earthquake of 2005 or the floods after 1992, 2010, 2014, or the earthquake of Mirpur in 2019, this region has been affected. He said that during the recent snowfall and rains, almost all major roads faced difficulties due to landslides, which were managed timely and efficiently through better planning. Prime Minister said that in the whole of Azad Kashmir, especially in Muzaffarabad and Poonch divisions, properties suffered damage. Loss of 8 precious lives and complete destruction of 88 houses occurred during the recent snowfall, while 221 houses were partially damaged. In addition, 4 temporary shelters, 26 shops, and other business establishments also suffered losses.

news.title: Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, the Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, participated in the swearing-in ceremony of the Prime Minister of Pakistan
news.body: Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, the Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, participated in the swearing-in ceremony of the Prime Minister of Pakistan, Muhammad Shahbaz Sharif. On this occasion, he congratulated Prime Minister Muhammad Shahbaz Sharif and expressed good wishes for him.

news.title: Prime Minister of the Azad Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq, met with Shah Ghulam Qadir, the President of the Muslim League-N Azad Kashmir
news.body: Prime Minister of the Azad Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq, met with Shah Ghulam Qadir, the President of the Muslim League-N Azad Kashmir. In the meeting, the current situation of Kashmir, development and progress in Azad Kashmir, and political matters were discussed. It was decided during this occasion that concerted efforts would be made to highlight the Kashmir issue, as it has reached a crucial juncture. In this regard, it is imperative for us to play our role from the Azadi Camp with full vigor, and in this process, all political parties must adopt a consensus stance on the Kashmir issue. We assure the people of occupied Kashmir that we will effectively convey their voice to the world at the global level. They said that without discrimination, we will pursue accountability and lead Azad Kashmir towards progress. Providing employment opportunities, development, prosperity, and improving the standard of living of the people is our top priority. The Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir stated that every person will witness changes in the state. The people will soon see improvements in the police, administration, and other departments. Serving the people of the state and providing basic facilities is our foremost priority. President of the Muslim League-N, Shah Ghulam Qadir, stated that they would fully support the government for the cause of freedom. He also appreciated the Prime Minister’s good governance initiatives and assured full support and assistance as an allied party, emphasizing that they would continue to play a significant role in the happiness and progress of the people.

news.title: Prime Minister of Azad Government of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq, has condemned further restrictions on two political parties by the Indian government in occupied Jammu and Kashmir.
news.body:
Prime Minister of Azad Government of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq, has condemned further restrictions on two political parties by the Indian government in occupied Jammu and Kashmir. Responding to the decision of the Indian government to impose restrictions on both factions of the Muslim Conference in occupied Jammu and Kashmir, the Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir said that India has snatched away all fundamental rights of the residents of occupied Kashmir. By imposing restrictions on writing, speaking, assembly, and political parties, India is closing all peaceful avenues for Kashmiris and leaving only the path of armed struggle for them. He said that India had closed all democratic paths for Kashmiris in 1987 and forced them into armed struggle by resorting to violence against them.

Chaudhry Anwar ul Haq said that India’s democracy and secularism are only superficial for the world to see. Attacks are carried out on the sacred places of all religious minorities by the government in India, and the land of India has become narrow for them. India has not only deprived the people of occupied Kashmir of their fundamental democratic right to self-determination but has also taken away all their personal freedoms. The international community should take note of India’s serious violations of human rights, crimes against humanity, and genocidal actions against Kashmiris. The Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir said that no oppression or tyranny of India can cool down the passion for freedom of the people of occupied Jammu and Kashmir.

The Azad Kashmir government, in consultation with the All Parties Hurriyat Conference, will expose India’s tyranny and violations of human rights in occupied Kashmir through relevant forums with a coherent and comprehensive strategy.

news.title: Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, chaired a high-level meeting of the Azad Kashmir State Disaster Management Commission.
news.body:
Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, chaired a high-level meeting of the Azad Kashmir State Disaster Management Commission at the Prime Minister’s Secretariat. The meeting was attended by senior officials including retired Colonel Waqar Ahmad Noor, Chaudhry Azhar Sadiq, Nasir Ansar Abdali, Chaudhry Amer Yasin, Advisor Sardar Ahmed Saeed, Chief Secretary Azad Kashmir Dawood Muhammad Barchi, Inspector General of Police Sahil Habib Tajik, Senior Board Member of Revenue, Principal Secretary for the Prime Minister, and other commission members. Director General of the State Disaster Management Authority Raja Tahir Mumtaz briefed the participants on the utilization of funds, duties performed during natural disasters, and other relevant details.

During the meeting, the commission approved an allocation of 69.950 million rupees from the State Disaster Management Fund for the purchase of relief items. Prime Minister Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq instructed to further strengthen the State Disaster Management Authority to deal effectively with natural disasters. He emphasized on providing training and refresher courses to SDMA employees to ensure their readiness at all times, enabling them to handle any sudden situations.

The Prime Minister reiterated that safeguarding the lives and property of the people is the government’s foremost responsibility. He directed the consolidation of 1122, Civil Defence, and State Disaster Management Authority into one institution to enhance its efficiency. He also ordered the conduct of vulnerability studies for Mirpur and Muzaffarabad at the first level. He suggested establishing a Task Force under the supervision of the Inspector General of Police to ensure the operational readiness of machinery present in the SDMA.

Furthermore, the Prime Minister pledged to provide additional machinery to rescue agencies to enable them to fulfill their duties efficiently during any natural calamity. He instructed that besides the establishment of a relief center in Muzaffarabad, 20% of relief supplies should also be kept in Poonch and Mirpur divisions to assist in any emergency. He emphasized on the procurement of all machinery and relief items through transparent tendering processes to ensure complete transparency.

news.title: Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, paid a surprise visit to the Secretariat at 8:30 AM on 20.02.2024.
news.body: Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, paid a surprise visit to the Secretariat at 8:30 AM this morning, Tuesday. He checked the biometric attendance of all secretaries and secretariat staff. Ninety percent of the secretaries were found present in their offices on this occasion. Prime Minister Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq expressed satisfaction with the attendance and active biometric system of the government secretaries and secretariat staff. While conversing with the secretaries, the Prime Minister said that ensuring good governance of the incumbent coalition government in Azad Jammu and Kashmir is a top priority so that available resources can be effectively utilized to provide facilities to the public and improve their welfare. Prime Minister Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, during his sudden visit to the Secretariat, expressed dissatisfaction when some senior secretaries of the government arrived at the office 30 to 40 minutes late. He directed them to strictly adhere to office hours.

news.title: Prime Minister AJ&K Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq presides over a session at University of Bhimber.
news.body:
Prime Minister of Azad Government State of Jammu and Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq said that serving the people of the state is my top priority. “University of Bhimber” will be an exemplary university of Azad Kashmir region, where not only students from Azad Kashmir but also from all over Pakistan including Punjab will aspire to enroll. Research conducted in universities abroad helps in shaping the future, according to global standards Bhimber University will function. Every individual in society should contribute to social welfare projects so that the state of Azad Kashmir can progress. Meritocracy, good governance, and making non-arbitrary decisions in institutions are necessary to maintain the supremacy of law and justice and to establish social equilibrium.

Providing education and healthcare to the people is my foremost priority. I am ensuring the protection of taxpayers’ money and will help the oppressed class in every possible way. Relief is being provided to the people throughout the state. There has been a significant improvement in the condition of Health Units. The standard of education in Azad Kashmir has been greatly improved. There is certainty about the supremacy of law. Accountability, good governance, and meritocracy are essential for the progress of states. I am rationalizing all institutions. All government employees should work diligently. I want improvement in all areas. Pay close attention to the health and education system.

The Prime Minister expressed these views while presiding over an important meeting at the Deputy Commissioner’s Office in Bhimber regarding the administrative affairs of the University of Bhimber, balancing expenditures in various departments, making the university active, and the functioning of other district departments. Deputy Commissioner Bhimber Marza Arshad Mahmood chaired the meeting and provided detailed briefings on administrative matters, various departments, and other issues of the university along with Registrar Dr. Abid Hussain, Treasurer Dr. Muhammad Saaim, and Deputy Registrar Muhammad Naveed.

Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq inquired from university authorities about the action plan regarding the provision of quality education to students, structural frameworks of all departments, and admissions. He emphasized working day and night to establish the university and its departments, so that the youth can benefit from this major project soon. The Prime Minister said that he wants to provide a system that benefits all future generations without discrimination. If the Prime Minister works 18 hours a day, then all other government employees should also work. Every person should fulfill their responsibilities diligently. University authorities informed that Vice-Chancellor Brigadier (R) Professor Dr. Yunus Javaid and the entire team are fully active and classes will start soon according to the Prime Minister’s vision. Prime Minister Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq salutes the services rendered by them, who have worked tirelessly day and night for the service of the people. Various district heads briefed the meeting administratively, and the Prime Minister directed the officers that there is a zero-tolerance policy in fulfilling duties, so work diligently and provide relief to the people.

news.title: The Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, has stated that the martyred Kashmiri freedom fighter, Afzal Guru, is the true hero who played a significant role in the freedom movement
news.body:
The Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, has stated that the martyred Kashmiri freedom fighter, Afzal Guru, is the true hero who played a significant role in the freedom movement. On the occasion of Afzal Guru’s martyrdom anniversary, the Prime Minister paid tribute to him in glowing terms, stating that the Indian Supreme Court’s decision to impose the death penalty to satisfy societal conscience clearly indicated that allegations against Afzal Guru were not proven, yet he was sentenced to death to appease societal conscience. His mortal remains were not handed over to his family; instead, they were buried in Tihar Jail.

He further mentioned that Afzal Guru’s entire life was a struggle; he never accepted the Indian occupation of occupied Kashmir and always raised his voice against it. He emphasized that Afzal Guru’s struggle against the coercion and oppression of the Indian army should be remembered. He hailed him as a hero of the Kashmiri people who will remain a hero. He asserted that the Kashmiri people’s struggle against India’s oppressive occupation will ultimately succeed, and one day, occupied Kashmir will be free from Indian control and become a part of Pakistan.

news.title: Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, Chaired a meeting of Agriculture and Livestock.
news.body: Under the presidency of Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, a meeting of the Department of Agriculture and Livestock was held. The meeting was attended by Senior Minister Colonel (Retired) Waqar Ahmed Noor, Minister of Agriculture Sardar Mir Akbar Khan, Minister of Communications Chaudhry Azhar Sadiq, Minister of Finance Abdul Majid Khan, Sardar Muhammad Hussain, Principal Secretary, and the Director General of the Agriculture Department. Secretary of Agriculture, Livestock, Aamir Mahmood Marza, provided a detailed briefing on various sectors including agriculture, livestock, dairy development, small dams, horticulture, irrigation, and other related areas. Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq stated that there is great potential in the agriculture and livestock sectors in Azad Kashmir. People should be encouraged towards farming, especially focusing on cultivating fruit-bearing plants. He emphasized that attention should be given to these sectors not only to enable people to save money but also to create employment opportunities through their development. Agriculture is an extremely important sector for the state, and there is a need to attract people to this field. The Prime Minister directed to provide maximum facilities to the farmers and urged officers to work in the field and initiate projects that benefit the people. He stressed the need to take steps to attract people towards agriculture and livestock. The Prime Minister instructed the Secretary of Agriculture and Livestock to present reports on the department’s activities and completed projects of the past five years within a week. He emphasized the need to work extensively in the livestock sector and to spend the available budget for the welfare of the people. The Prime Minister said that we need to focus on our agriculture and teach farmers scientific methods of cultivation so that they can become self-sufficient in crops. He advocated for promoting poultry farming and providing interest-free loans especially for dairy farms so that young people pay attention to it and not only benefit themselves but also become a source of support for their families. The Prime Minister emphasized working with dedication and focusing on these sectors to bring progress according to the demands of the modern era and make the people happy.

news.title: PM AJ&K Chaudhry Anwar-ul-haq inaugurates TEVTA Brand Launching Ceremony for branding handicrafts and traditional dresses of Kashmir
news.body: Muzaffarabad (PIID) February 5, 2024 Minister Toyota Amir Altaf said that the establishment of the Toyota New Complex is the forefront of modern education. We need to establish strong mechanisms to support the daily wages of strong youth. Toyota will become a self-sufficient institution. Focusing on skill education will eliminate unemployment. Addressing the inauguration of the AJ Toyota Complex and the launch of the website, Minister Toyota Amir Altaf said that the establishment of the Toyota Complex is aimed at promoting skill education. Youth need to be attracted towards skill education. The government’s capacity for employment in the setup is extremely limited. He said that it is necessary to attract youth towards digital education so that unemployment can be eradicated. He said that Toyota will play a significant role in promoting digital skills. news.title: On the occasion of Kashmir Solidarity Day, a special session of the Legislative Assembly of Azad Jammu and Kashmir was convened.
news.body:
On the occasion of Kashmir Solidarity Day, a special session of the Legislative Assembly of Azad Jammu and Kashmir was convened under the presidency of Speaker Chaudhry Latif Akbar on Monday. For the session, the Speaker appointed a panel of chairpersons, including Raja Muhammad Farooq Haider Khan, Chaudhry Muhammad Yasin, and Sardar Abdul Qayyum Niazi.

During this event, prayers were offered for the widow of former President of Azad Kashmir, Begum Shireen Khurshid, for the martyrs of Kashmir, the Armed Forces of Pakistan, and also for the late Haji Khursheed. Addressing the assembly, Speaker Chaudhry Latif Akbar extended a warm welcome to the Chief Guest, Prime Minister of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Anwar-ul-Haq Kakar.

He mentioned that the special session on the occasion of Kashmir Solidarity Day would boost the morale of the people of Kashmir on this side of the Line of Control (LoC). Speaker Chaudhry Latif Akbar stated that the relentless efforts for the self-determination rights of the people of Kashmir have always been supported by the State of Pakistan, Pakistani people, and governments.

He expressed that the Kashmiris have been enduring the oppression and barbarism of India for the past 75 years. The purpose of Kashmir Solidarity Day is to raise a voice against the tyranny and brutality of India in occupied Kashmir. He added that every year on Kashmir Solidarity Day, the President or Prime Minister of Pakistan visits and addresses the Legislative Assembly, and today the people of Azad Kashmir are eager to hear the message from the Prime Minister of Pakistan.

Speaker Chaudhry Latif Akbar anticipated that the address by the Prime Minister in the Legislative Assembly and the condemnation of Indian actions would send a positive message beyond the Line of Control, providing a new direction to the Kashmir freedom movement.

Mirpur (PIA), February 5, 2024

On the occasion of Kashmir Solidarity Day, while addressing a special session of the Legislative Assembly, Opposition Leader Khawaja Farooq Ahmed stated that on this day, the people and governments of Pakistan reaffirm their commitment to unity with the Kashmiris. Despite Pakistan facing financial, political, and diplomatic challenges, it has consistently shown commitment to the moral, political, and diplomatic support of the Kashmiris.

He emphasized that a strong and stable Pakistan is the key to the success of the Kashmir freedom movement. A strong Pakistan can engage in dialogue with India and has demonstrated commitment over the past 75 years. He said that all political parties in Azad Kashmir are united on the issue of Kashmir. On this day, by crossing the Line of Control, we want to convey a message to the people of Kashmir that the 22-party government and the people are behind them in their struggle for freedom.

He stated that the day is not far when we will see the flag of Pakistan waving at Lal Chowk in Srinagar. He expressed hope that under the leadership of Prime Minister Anwar-ul-Haq Kakar, peaceful elections in Pakistan would be possible. He urged the Prime Minister to take initiatives for the welfare of migrants in Azad Kashmir, including providing health cards.

Mirpur (PIA), February 5, 2024

On the occasion of Kashmir Solidarity Day, a special session of the Legislative Assembly was adjourned indefinitely after a day’s proceedings. The session was convened to address the unity sentiments with the people of Kashmir and condemn the illegal actions of India. Both resolutions presented in this regard were unanimously approved.

news.title: PM AJ&K Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq adresses on the AJK assembly floor to the session held on Kashmir Solidarity Day observed on Feb5,2024
news.body:
Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, has stated that the Kashmir Solidarity Day reflects the deep emotional connection between Pakistan and the people of Kashmir. On this day, he expressed gratitude to the vigilant Prime Minister of Pakistan, Anwar-ul-Haq Kakar, and Army Chief General Asim Munir, for addressing the issues of the people of Azad Kashmir and unveiling human rights violations by India.

He emphasized that Pakistan is the destination for the people of Kashmir, and he acknowledged the sacrifices of the Pakistani forces in defending and ensuring the safety of Azad Kashmir. Addressing the Indian Prime Minister Modi, he warned that any aggression or desire at any level will be met with a strong response.

Speaking at a special session of the Azad Jammu and Kashmir Assembly on Kashmir Solidarity Day, Prime Minister Anwar-ul-Haq Kakar conveyed his appreciation. He declared that on this day, the people of Pakistan, Azad Kashmir, and Kashmiris worldwide stand united. He highlighted the establishment of the Jammu and Kashmir Freedom Council in collaboration with freedom fighters as a practical step.

He assured that resources would only be spent on the freedom movement and the rights of the people. The Prime Minister asserted that the preservation of the rights of the freedom movement and the region’s people is the top priority, emphasizing that power is not the ultimate goal.

Acknowledging the global Kashmiri diaspora, he expressed gratitude for raising the Kashmir issue internationally. He stressed the importance of global attention to the Kashmir issue based on social awareness. The Prime Minister expressed hope that the elected government, after February 8, would vigorously address the Kashmir issue.

He concluded by affirming that Kashmir is an integral part of Pakistan, and the day is not far when occupied Kashmir will be free and integrated with Pakistan. He emphasized passing on the ideological connection with Pakistan to future generations, redirecting the means of Azad Kashmir towards the freedom movement for the liberation of occupied Kashmir from Indian control.

news.title: Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, has stated that India’s democracy and secularism are the biggest fraud
news.body: Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, has stated that India’s democracy and secularism are the biggest fraud in the eyes of the world. There is neither religious freedom for minorities in India, nor are their religious places safe. India, claiming to be a champion of democracy, has deprived the people of Kashmir of their democratic rights and right to self-determination for the past 77 years. Republic Day in India is a black day for us. India has forcibly occupied Kashmir. Over the past seven decades, India has maintained a market of oppression and tyranny in occupied Kashmir through undemocratic means. The prevailing black laws in occupied Kashmir are explicitly against democratic principles. What has happened in occupied Kashmir since August 5, does that resemble the actions of a democratic country? The Kashmir freedom movement is a movement for peace in Asia. There is no place for minorities in India. Minorities living in India are afraid of extremist rulers. The actions of destroying the Babri Masjid in government leadership, attacking the sacred place of Sikhs, the Golden Temple, and burning Christian churches every day are not secularism but Hindu supremacist ideologies, according to which India is only a country for religiously fanatic Hindus. In his special statement, the Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir said that after August 5, 2019, the lives of the Kashmiri people have been transformed into a prison. India’s action on August 5 is a serious violation of United Nations agreements. Prime Minister Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq said that he appreciates the enthusiasm for freedom of the Kashmiris and pays tribute to the millions of martyrs who have kept the flame of the movement alive with their warm blood and have not let the spirit of freedom cool despite difficult circumstances and challenges. Kashmir can never be a part of India. For the freedom movement, Kashmiris have sacrificed their third generation. They thanked all the countries, institutions, and organizations that raised their voices for the Kashmiris. He said that the world has promised to give Kashmiris the right to self-determination. According to the agreements of the United Nations, Kashmiris want their fundamental right of self-determination, for which they will continue their struggle until the last drop of blood.

Islamabad (PID) January 24, 2024

The Prime Minister of Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, has expressed deep sorrow and grief over the demise of elder brother of the Chief Editor “Ausaf” and the Chief Executive of A B News, Mehtab Khan. Islamabad (PID) January 24, 2024

Prime Minister of the Azad Government of the State of Jammu and Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq met with the Member of the Azad Jammu and Kashmir Legislative Assembly, Chaudhry Muhammad Ismail, who called on to PM AJ&K at the Jammu and Kashmir House in Islamabad. Prime Minister of Azad Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, congratulated Member of the Assembly Chaudhry Muhammad Ismail on his successful re-election and expressed that he would play a full role both inside and outside the assembly for the service of the people.He stated that, as a member of the assembly, they would work diligently for the welfare of the people, both within and outside the assembly. Prime Minister Azad Kashmir, Chaudhry Anwar-ul-Haq, emphasized that they have initiated comprehensive measures in collaboration with allied political parties for the progress and prosperity of the state and to improve the standard of living for the people. He asserted that the government would not tolerate any compromise on good governance, merit, adherence to the constitution, and the provision of justice.

pages.title: The Kashmir Cause
pages.subtitle: Kashmir: the oldest dispute on the UN agenda
pages.body:
## Kashmir, the oldest dispute on the UN agenda

The Kashmir dispute is the oldest unresolved international conflict in the world today. Pakistan considers Kashmir its core political dispute with India, and so does the international community, except India.

India's forcible occupation of the State of Jammu and Kashmir in 1947 is the main cause of the dispute. India claims that the Maharaja of Kashmir "signed" a controversial document, the Instrument of Accession, on 26 October 1947, in return for India's military help against a popular uprising. The people of Kashmir and Pakistan do not accept the Indian claim, and there are doubts about the very existence of the Instrument of Accession. The United Nations does not consider the Indian claim legally valid: it recognises Kashmir as a disputed territory. With the exception of India, the entire world community recognises Kashmir as a disputed territory.

All the principles on which the Indian subcontinent was partitioned by the British in 1947 justify Kashmir becoming a part of Pakistan: the State had a Muslim-majority population, it was geographically contiguous with Pakistan, and it had essential economic links with the territories that make up Pakistan.

## History of the dispute

The State of Jammu and Kashmir has historically remained independent, except in the anarchic conditions of the late 18th and first half of the 19th century, or when it was part of the vast empires of the Mauryas (3rd century BC), the Mughals (16th to 18th century) and the British (mid-19th to mid-20th century). All these empires included not only present-day India and Pakistan but other countries of the region as well.

Until 1846, Kashmir was part of the Sikh empire. In that year the British defeated the Sikhs and sold Kashmir to Gulab Singh of Jammu for Rs. 7.5 million under the Treaty of Amritsar. Gulab Singh, the Maharaja, signed a separate treaty with the British which gave him the status of an independent princely ruler of Kashmir. Gulab Singh died in 1857 and was succeeded by Ranbir Singh (1857-1885). Two other Maharajas, Partab Singh (1885-1925) and Hari Singh (1925-1949), ruled in succession.

Gulab Singh and his successors ruled Kashmir in a tyrannical and repressive way. The people of Kashmir, nearly 80 per cent of whom were Muslims, rose against Maharaja Hari Singh's rule. He ruthlessly crushed a mass uprising in 1931. In 1932, Sheikh Abdullah and Chaudhry Ghulam Abbas formed Kashmir's first political party, the All Jammu & Kashmir Muslim Conference (a faction of which was renamed the National Conference in 1939). In 1934 the Maharaja gave way and allowed limited democracy in the form of a Legislative Assembly. However, unease with the Maharaja's rule continued.

Under the plan for the partition of India, the rulers of princely states were given the choice to accede to either India or Pakistan, or to remain independent. They were, however, advised to accede to the contiguous dominion, taking geographical and ethnic factors into account.

In Kashmir, however, the Maharaja hesitated. The mainly Muslim population, having seen the early and covert arrival of Indian troops, rebelled, and events slipped out of the Maharaja's hands. The people of Kashmir were demanding to join Pakistan. The Maharaja eventually gave way to Indian pressure and agreed to join India by, as India claims, "signing" the controversial Instrument of Accession on 26 October 1947. Kashmir was provisionally accepted into the Indian Union pending a free and impartial plebiscite. This was spelled out in a letter from the Governor General of India, Lord Mountbatten, to the Maharaja on 27 October 1947. In that letter, accepting the accession, Mountbatten made it clear that the State would only be incorporated into the Indian Union after a reference had been made to the people of Kashmir. Having accepted the principle of a plebiscite, India has since obstructed every attempt to hold one.

In 1947 India and Pakistan went to war over Kashmir. During the war it was India which first took the Kashmir dispute to the United Nations, on 1 January 1948. A year later, on 1 January 1949, the UN helped bring about a ceasefire between the two countries. The ceasefire line was renamed the Line of Control under the Simla Agreement of 1972.

With the mutual consent of India and Pakistan, the UN Security Council (UNSC) and the UN Commission for India and Pakistan (UNCIP) passed several resolutions in the years following the 1947-48 war. The UNSC Resolution of 21 April 1948, one of the principal UN resolutions on Kashmir, stated that "both India and Pakistan desire that the question of the accession of Jammu and Kashmir to India or Pakistan should be decided through the democratic method of a free and impartial plebiscite". Later UNSC resolutions reiterated the same position. The UNCIP resolutions of 13 August 1948 and 5 January 1949 reinforced the UNSC resolutions.

## The Kashmir issue in a nutshell

The current struggle in Indian Illegally Occupied Jammu & Kashmir (IIOJK) is rooted in the struggle of the people for the exercise of their right of self-determination. Peaceful processions demanding freedom have been fired upon by the Indian Army and police. Thousands of men, women and children have been killed or wounded.

New Delhi's allegation of assistance to the Kashmiri people from the Pakistan side is unfounded. Objective reports in the foreign media testify that the Kashmiri movement is indigenous.

Pakistan upholds the right of the people of Jammu and Kashmir to self-determination in accordance with the resolutions of the UN Security Council. These resolutions of 1948 and 1949 provide for a free and impartial plebiscite to determine the future of the State by the people of Jammu and Kashmir.

The basic points about the UN resolutions are:

- The complaint relating to Kashmir was initiated by India in the Security Council.
- The Council, explicitly and by implication, rejected India's claim that Kashmir is legally Indian territory.
- The resolutions established self-determination as the governing principle for the settlement of the Kashmir dispute. This is the world body's commitment to the people of Kashmir.
- The resolutions endorsed a binding agreement between India and Pakistan, reached through the mediation of UNCIP, that a plebiscite would be held under agreed and specified conditions.
- The Security Council has rejected the Indian contention that the people of Kashmir have exercised their right of self-determination by taking part in the "elections" which India has organised from time to time in the occupied territory. The very low turnout in the 1989 "elections" was a clear repudiation of the Indian claim.
- Pakistan continues to adhere to the UN resolutions. They are binding on India as well.

## The Simla Agreement

The Simla Agreement of 2 July 1972, to which Pakistan also continues to adhere, did not alter the status of Jammu and Kashmir as a disputed territory:

- Para 6 of the Agreement lists "a final settlement of Jammu and Kashmir" as one of the outstanding questions awaiting settlement.
- Para 4 (ii) speaks of a "Line of Control" as distinguished from an international border. It also explicitly protects "the recognized position of either side". The recognised position of Pakistan is the one recognised by the United Nations and the world community in general.
- Article 1 (iv) clearly refers to the Kashmir issue when it speaks of "the basic issues and causes of conflict which have bedevilled the relations between the two countries for the last 25 years".
